An Ivory & Red Celebration

Jaali arches, brass and jasmine

Event
Wedding
Venue
Jaypee Greens
Location
Greater Noida
Date
July 2024
Guests
350+
Category
Wedding

Ivory jaali screens, brass finials and strings of jasmine and red roses created a calm, traditional setting for a monsoon wedding.

A long arched corridor with chandeliers and brass spires led guests into the venue. Inside, carved lotus panels glowed with warm uplighting.

The mandap was framed by banana leaves and white urns, with hanging garlands of jasmine and red roses above the couple.

  • Arched entrance corridor
  • Lit lotus panels
  • Jasmine and rose garland mandap
  • Brass bells and pomegranate details
